_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: Hugo site
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Hugo is a fast static site generator. The egg builds your Hugo site from a Git repository or the site folder at every start, then serves it with Caddy.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ] && [ -d site/.git ]; then git -C site pull --ff-only && git -C site submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 || echo "git pull failed: building the site as it is."; fi; ./hugo build --source site --destination ../public --cleanDestinationDir --minify ${BASE_URL:+--baseURL "$BASE_URL"} || { echo "Hugo couldn't build the site: see the errors above."; exit 1; }; exec ./caddy run --config Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash # Hugo site: downloads Hugo (extended) and Caddy from their GitHub releases, # checked against GitHub's SHA-256, and clones the site's Git repository # into the site folder (with its theme submodules), or writes a starter # site. The site's files and the Caddyfile are never touched once there. set -euo pipefail cd /mnt/server fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; } work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work" trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) arch=amd64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; *) fail "Hugo has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;; esac version="${VERSION:-latest}" [ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}" tag=$(gh-release tag gohugoio/hugo "$version") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 0.170.0, then reinstall." if [ -x hugo ] && [ "$(cat .hugo-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then echo "Hugo $tag is already installed." else echo "Downloading Hugo $tag." gh-release download gohugoio/hugo "$tag" "hugo_extended_${tag#v}_linux-${arch}.tar.gz" "$work/hugo.tar.gz" tar -xzf "$work/hugo.tar.gz" -C "$work" hugo install -m 0755 "$work/hugo" hugo.new mv -f hugo.new hugo echo "$tag" > .hugo-version fi caddy=$(gh-release tag caddyserver/caddy latest) || exit 1 if [ -x caddy ] && [ "$(cat .caddy-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$caddy" ]; then echo "Caddy $caddy is already installed." else echo "Downloading Caddy $caddy." gh-release download caddyserver/caddy "$caddy" "caddy_${caddy#v}_linux_${arch}.tar.gz" "$work/caddy.tar.gz" tar -xzf "$work/caddy.tar.gz" -C "$work" caddy install -m 0755 "$work/caddy" caddy.new mv -f caddy.new caddy echo "$caddy" > .caddy-version fi if [ ! -f Caddyfile ]; then cat > Caddyfile <<'CADDY' # Caddy's settings: https://caddyserver.com/docs/caddyfile # Caddy listens on the server's port ({$SERVER_PORT}) and serves the site # Hugo builds into the public folder. Restart the server after changing it. { admin off log { format console } } :{$SERVER_PORT} { root * public encode file_server } CADDY fi mkdir -p site url="${GIT_ADDRESS:-}" if [ -n "$url" ]; then case "$url" in *.git) ;; *) url="$url.git" ;; esac if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then url="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${url#https://}" fi fi if [ -d site/.git ]; then echo "The site's repository is already here: pulling the latest changes." git -C site pull --ff-only git -C site submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 elif [ -n "$(ls -A site)" ]; then echo "The site folder already has files and isn't a Git repository, so nothing was cloned." elif [ -n "$url" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$url" site else echo "No Git repository set: writing a starter site. Replace the site folder with your own." mkdir -p site/content site/layouts/_default cat > site/hugo.toml <<'TOML' title = "My Hugo site" TOML cat > site/content/_index.md <<'MD' --- title: It works --- Upload your Hugo site to the site folder, or set a Git repository and reinstall, to replace this page. MD cat > site/layouts/_default/baseof.html <<'HTML' {{ .Title }} {{ block "main" . }}{{ end }} HTML cat > site/layouts/_default/list.html <<'HTML' {{ define "main" }}

{{ .Title }}

{{ .Content }}{{ end }} HTML cp site/layouts/_default/list.html site/layouts/_default/single.html fi echo "Installed Hugo $tag and Caddy $caddy."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Hugo version to install, such as 0.170.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: An https link to the site's repository, cloned into the site folder when the server is installed. Leave it empty to upload the site yourself.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: The branch to clone. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Your username on the Git host, for a private repository.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: An access token that can read the private repository.

variables.name: Pull updates at start
variables.description: Pull the repository's latest changes every time the server starts, before building.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: The site's full address with http or https in front, used for its links. Empty uses the one in the site's settings.
